'''Yura Telamarch''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bezim (species)|Bezim]] who became the ruler of [[Bezim|his homeworld]]. He was in an alliance (resulting in the creation of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] gateway, [[Station 88 Spaceport]]) with [[Lorian Nod]] of [[Junction V]], [[Samish Kash]] of [[Delaluna]], and [[Glimmer Uziel]] of [[Vicondor/Legends|Vicondor]].

Telamarch was a tall [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] with a domed head and a grave manner.
